name: clickhouse-sql
description: Syntax highlighting and syntax checking for ClickHouse SQL
author: Valery Petrov <valerypetrov@icloud.com>

enumDescriptions: Keywords keep the case they are written in
clickhouseSql.format.keywordCase.description: The case of keywords when formatting ClickHouse SQL.

clickhouseSql.maxFileSize.description: Files longer than this many characters get no syntax check, semantic highlighting, formatting, outline, folding, Expand Selection, completion, hover, signature help, go to definition, references, rename or server check, which would slow VS Code down.

clickhouseSql.server.enabled.markdownDescription: Check names, functions and types against a ClickHouse server, and complete its databases, tables and columns. Each SELECT, and the SELECT of `CREATE ... AS SELECT` and `INSERT ... SELECT`, is sent as `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` with `readonly=1`, so nothing is changed; the server still runs its scalar subqueries, within limits of 2 s, rows, bytes and memory. The names come from `system.databases`, `system.tables` and `system.columns`.

clickhouseSql.server.url.description: The HTTP interface of the ClickHouse server.

clickhouseSql.server.user.markdownDescription: The ClickHouse user. Set its password with the **ClickHouse SQL: Set Server Password** command.

clickhouseSql.server.database.description: The database of table names without one; empty for the default database of the user.

clickhouseSql.server.timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the server, in milliseconds.

scripts.build:e2e: esbuild test/e2e/run.ts test/e2e/index.ts test/e2e/extension.test.ts test/e2e/format.test.ts test/e2e/complete.test.ts test/e2e/server.test.ts test/e2e/semantic.test.ts test/e2e/folding.test.ts test/e2e/outline.test.ts test/e2e/selection.test.ts test/e2e/names.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:vscode --external:@vscode/test-electron --log-override:require-resolve-not-external=silent --outdir=out/e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:e2e && node out/e2e/run.js
scripts.test:e2e:stress: npm run build && npm run build:e2e:stress && node out/e2e/stress-run.js
scripts.test:e2e:corpus: npm run build && npm run build:e2e:corpus && node out/e2e/corpus-run.js
